ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with minimal high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing less than 5% of the total fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Nearly uniform black contiguous area across both lobes; discrete, high-contrast white circular focal spots are localized primarily on the left lobe upper-distal region and the central medial area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged; left lobe exhibits several deep notches (amplitudes of ~15-20 pixels); right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of smaller, more uniform serrations (~5-10 pixel amplitude).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves extending laterally from the median notch, terminating in sharp tips with a slight downward distal orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (~5-15 pixels in diameter) visible in the upper-left quadrant and near the peduncle attachment point.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (approx. 40 pixels in length) visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, deep semi-circular indentation is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from natural serration topography.
other_distinctive_markers: The ventral surface displays near-total black pigmentation, which is a distinctive high-melanin variant for this species.
